ja390:1.1: 'ti. Sakuṇo Mayhako nāma girīsānudarīcaro pakkaṃ pipphalam āruyha mayha mayhan 'ti kandati.
ja390:2.1: Tass' eva vilapantassa dijasaṃghā samāgatā, bhutvāna pipphaliṃ yanti, vilapi tv-eva so dijo.
ja390:3.1: Evam eva idh' ekacco saṃgharitvā bahuṃ dhanaṃ n' ev' attano na ñātīnaṃ yathodhiṃ paṭipajjati.
ja390:4.1: Na so acchādanaṃ bhattaṃ na mālaṃ na vilepanaṃ anubhoti sakiṃ kiñci na saṃgaṇhāti ñātake.
ja390:5.1: Tass' eva vilapantassa mayha mayhan ti rakkhato rājāno atha vā corā dāyādā yeva appiyā dhanam ādāya gacchanti, vilapi tv-eva so naro.
ja390:6.1: Dhīro bhoge adhigamma saṃgaṇhāti ca ñātake, tena so kittiṃ pappoti pecca sagge ca modatīti.
